_comment: sunbird plugin — knowledge-based identification (KBI) rather than OTP, so
auth_factor is kbi and the identity answers are full_name + dob. Those name a
real person in the registry, so they are left empty here: put them in
config.local.json (gitignored) along with individual_id, or pass
INDIVIDUAL_ID / KBI_FULL_NAME / KBI_DOB. Same for api.flow_client_id, which
names a client registered on your own deployment.
The KBI flow and a seeded registry must exist on the target environment; if
they do not, scenarios report ENV_NOT_READY / failures at runtime rather than
being rejected as a config error.
Two conformance plans run back to back, each with its own client/jwks file
for the template). The fapi2 entry pins profile=full because only
default to full; the pin only matters if you narrow run.profile to smoke.
FAPI also drives two clients, so
its config_file needs client AND client2 filled in.
To run just the oidcc plan: drop the second entry (or point both config_file
values at the same file if the same clients are registered for both).
